This page contains only the final aggregate figures for copying into
manuscripts, presentations, and other publication materials. Select or open an
image to copy it at full resolution. Each figure also has a print PDF, laid out
at its size in the journal (one column = 246 pt, full width = 504 pt) with 7–8 pt
text and Lato embedded. The figures carry no titles; the captions below give the
definitions that belong in a manuscript caption.

::: {.publication-figures}
